purpose: Evaluate one deterministic full-gallery generative candidate, lowrank_gaussian, using class templates and a shared residual covariance Sigma=L L^T+diag(d), exact Woodbury whitening, and finite-template/repeat predictive covariance. This is a new correlated-noise model, not a reranker, Poisson reparameterization, or score-fusion search. Development reuse is neither pristine validation nor a Kaggle result.
scope: Create files only under test/52_lowrank_gaussian. Do not modify src, other experiments, or Git history. Experiment 48 code and completed development outputs are read-only comparator/evaluation utilities. Do not read any real experiment metrics before --run and do not depend on experiment 49, 50, or 51 outputs.

data.raw_counts: Shared unnormalized 25ms uint16 trial counts; the only transform is log1p after split isolation.
data.gallery: Public pictures.npy, read-only, binarized as (pictures >= 128).astype(float32) solely for official OCF.

task2.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task2', seed=42, validation_session=s) for s in session1, session2, session3, in that order
task2.training: For each mouse independently, only train_trials from the other three complete sessions enter templates and covariance.
task2.validation: The entire held-out target session supplies unlabeled trials for one target-session marginal. Local GT is used only after model fitting to form official four-repeat groups and select evaluation rows.

task3.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task3', seed=s) for s in 20261126 and 20261127, in that order
task3.training: For each mouse independently, each block has exactly three disjoint training repeats per glyph. Fit separate block templates and pool only their within-block residuals into one covariance per mouse-fold.
task3.validation: Exactly one disjoint validation single trial per glyph per block. No target marginal, labels, or repeat aggregation enters fitting or scoring.

arm.name: lowrank_gaussian
arm.epoch_field_adapter: Result rows carry epoch=1 only for experiment 48 aggregation compatibility; it is not checkpoint selection.

transform_and_templates.transform: z=log1p(raw_count), computed in float64 for sufficient statistics; no log-count standardization and no image-prior regression.
transform_and_templates.task2_source_alignment: For each of three source blocks, offset_b=mean(z over all its train trials). reference_offset=mean(offset_b over three blocks). aligned_z=z-offset_b+reference_offset. Each class template mu_c is the arithmetic mean of its 12 aligned source trials.
transform_and_templates.task2_target_alignment: target_offset=mean(z over all 10992 unlabeled held-session trials), without targets. Each aligned validation value is z-target_offset+reference_offset. The query is the arithmetic mean of four aligned repeats; equivalently average the four raw z values before applying the same offset.
transform_and_templates.task2_residuals: Every aligned source single trial minus its global class template; N=32976 and G=2748 per mouse-fold.
transform_and_templates.task3_templates: For each block independently, mu_bc is the arithmetic mean of that block's three raw-z training trials for class c. No cross-block template pooling or target alignment.
transform_and_templates.task3_residuals: Every raw-z source single trial minus its own block-class template; pool residuals across four blocks, with N=32976 and G=10992 per mouse-fold.
transform_and_templates.template_dtype: float64 sufficient statistics; float32 copies only for CUDA scoring

residual_covariance.formula: C=(E^T E)/(N-G), where E contains the specified residuals and G is the number of fitted class or block-class templates.
residual_covariance.eigendecomposition: Descending float64 eigenpairs of C; retain exactly rank[task].
residual_covariance.covariance_pooling: Within each mouse-fold only; never across mice, folds, tasks, or validation trials.

predictive_likelihood.model: query mean given class is Gaussian with mean mu_c and covariance kappa*(L L^T+diag(d)); kappa is identical across classes.
predictive_likelihood.finite_template_posterior: The 1/n_template_repeats term is mandatory; no plug-in-only likelihood.
predictive_likelihood.woodbury: A=L/sqrt(d); H=I+A^T A. For residual r=(query-mu_c)/sqrt(d), squared Mahalanobis q=r^T r-(A^T r)^T H^-1(A^T r).
predictive_likelihood.score: score=-0.5*q/kappa. Omit log determinant because Sigma and kappa are shared by every class.
predictive_likelihood.candidate_matrix: Expand q using only two-dimensional query-by-class and rank-sized matrices and GEMMs. Never construct query-by-class-by-feature or query-by-class-by-rank tensors.
predictive_likelihood.scoring_device: CUDA float32 GEMMs with TF32 disabled; CPU float64 is permitted for synthetic hand-checks.
predictive_likelihood.score_modification: None: no production logits, top-32 restriction, fusion, temperature, calibration weights, or reranking.

evaluation.implementation: Import experiment 48 OcfPairCache, evaluate_logits, subset_positions and corrected aggregate_rows unchanged.
evaluation.rows: Use local GT only to construct Task2 official groups and select the same sorted 256 development targets. Score those queries against all 2748 classes. Task3 evaluates one 256x2748 single-trial matrix per block.
evaluation.hungarian: Experiment 48 evaluate_logits/src.retrieval.unique_assignment independently on every raw 256x2748 score matrix.
evaluation.aggregation: Block rows -> mouse_fold -> mouse/fold/macro using the corrected n_evaluation_rows propagation.
evaluation.ocf_scale: Native official score scale; the +3 gate is an absolute assigned_final_ocf difference.

reference48.comparator: production_recipe at its own already-selected best macro epoch independently in Task2 and Task3; do not retrain or re-select it.
reference48.integrity: Before cache/CUDA access, validate both hashes, selection linkage, preregistration linkage, subset, selected epochs, and expected evaluation row counts.
reference48.parameter_independence: No candidate constant, rank, fold, or model choice is derived from experiment 48, 49, 50, or 51 metrics. Reference metrics are read only for comparison during --run, never during smoke.

advancement_gate.comparison: lowrank_gaussian minus experiment 48 production_recipe at production's own selected epoch, independently within each task; the candidate has no epoch selection.
advancement_gate.per_mouse: Both mouse-level assigned_final_ocf deltas must be >=0 in each task.
advancement_gate.folds: Fold-level assigned_final_ocf deltas averaged over two mice must be nonnegative for at least 2/3 Task2 folds and 2/2 Task3 folds.
advancement_gate.outcome: All per-task gates must pass for overall advance=true. Otherwise stop with no alternate rank, variance floor, template rule, covariance rule, or other hyperparameter search. Passing development still requires separately authorized pristine/final validation.

audits.per_mouse_fold: Record train/validation roles and counts, N/G/df, n and R, kappa, rank, eigenvalues, diagonal floor counts, template/covariance/loading/diagonal hashes, and exact target-marginal label isolation.
audits.isolation_smoke: Changing held-out features cannot change train-derived templates or covariance; changing held-out labels cannot change Task2 target marginal or any fitted model; changing training features must change fitted statistics.
audits.numerical_smoke: Compare expanded Woodbury scores with direct dense inverse solves on a hand-sized example; verify finite scores, covariance diagonal reconstruction, kappa values, full candidate axis, and two-dimensional GEMMs only.
audits.gate_smoke: Exercise positive, macro-negative, mouse-negative and fold-negative selection cases.

outputs.overwrite_policy: Refuse --run if either output already exists.

prohibited: Task2 session4 validation or final evaluation
hidden test labels or sample-ID/target alignment
validation labels for template, covariance, offset, or score construction
rank, variance-floor, covariance, template, or score-weight search
